svg.title: SENTINEL architecture
svg.desc: One ensemble member of the SENTINEL sleep-onset forecaster and the 7-member final ensemble.
svg.text: Causal streaming forecaster of time to first N2. Every 5 s it receives one packet of Muse EEG and outputs a countdown in seconds.

g.text: no filtering, one packet per call
red trace: AF8 electrode loosens mid-night
per second: 2 s Hann frame, 1 s hop
quality probe: flat, clip, NaN, mains,
40% of nights get a fault: dead or noisy
same weights for every electrode + channel embedding
reliability r_c = σ(MLP[q_c, e_c]), supervised by the fault mask
a set of electrodes, not a fixed 4-channel layout
MLP(pair features), weighted by r_i · r_j
+ log Σ r_i r_j (how much good signal is left)
A broken electrode gets almost no attention, and the
rest produce a token from the same distribution.
old fixed-layout model 94.6 s → SENTINEL 36.5 s
packet token p_k = W[last second ; 5 s mean]
+ FM term pooled by reliability, zero-initialised
input: p_k, its 1-, 4- and 16-min trailing means,
p_k − mean since stream start, log(1 + t / 60 s)
Loss per night (each night counts once, like the metric):
+ L1 to a lookahead teacher that saw 30 s of the future (students)
Final ensemble: blind-test W-bMAE 33.52 s; the whole test set streams in 2,956 s of a 3,600 s A100 budget
features and the FM call are computed once per packet and shared by all members
